description: This file contains functions for exporting database recordsets to CSV and Tab-delimited formats, including options to output to files, stdout, and as strings. It provides customizable export settings and handles data sanitization for CSV compatibility.

methods.name: rs2csv
methods.description: Returns a recordset as a CSV string.

methods.name: rs2csvfile
methods.description: Writes the recordset to a CSV file.

methods.name: rs2csvout
methods.description: Outputs the recordset as CSV to stdout.

methods.name: rs2tab
methods.description: Returns a recordset as a tab-delimited string.

methods.name: rs2tabfile
methods.description: Writes the recordset to a tab-delimited file.

methods.name: rs2tabout
methods.description: Outputs the recordset as tab-delimited to stdout.

methods.name: _adodb_export
methods.description: Core function that formats and exports the recordset to CSV or tab-delimited formats, with options for output destination and formatting.
